units: <cite ref="Yoma 75a:1">Yoma 75ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>מישרים</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 23:31">Prov. XXIII, 31</cite>) <he>עריות כולן דומות עליו כמ׳</he> all forbidden connections appear to him like a common (to which all have access).

<cite ref="Proverbs 23:31">Ib.</cite> <he>כל העולם … כמ׳</he> the entire world appears to him like a common (he disregards other people’s rights); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:2">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>עושה אותן הפקר כמ׳</he> he considers all sins free like a common.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:2">Ib.</cite> <he>שנוטלין … בתיהם כמ׳</he> they (the oppressors) carry off all that belongs to them (the Jews), and their houses are left levelled like a common. Tanḥ. R’eh 3 <he>אחת תחלתה קוצים וסופה מ׳ ואחת תחלתה מ׳ וכ׳</he> one road full of thorns in the beginning but level in the end, and one level in the beginning &c.; a. e.
